capabilities: Reorder checklist items automatically when checkboxes are toggled
Move checkbox lines together with their indented content
Renumber numbered lists automatically as you type
Preserve list numbering when pasting content into existing lists
Run manual commands to reorder checkboxes or renumber lists per selection or note
extras: Installation requires matching the plugin's tab-size setting to the editor's indent size for accurate parsing; README documents known conflicts with modifier keys and Obsidian's default smart lists, and mentions documents with over 10,000 list lines were tested.
problem: Obsidian leaves checked/unchecked checklist items and broken numbered-list numbering in place, requiring manual reordering and renumbering.
summary: List automation plugin that reorders checklist items and renumbers numbered lists as you edit them.
